formal config 1.0 and 1.1 cannot start new paid stages even if credentials and historical evidence exist
preflight requires current Protocol 1.8, Study 1.2, source identity, and a valid pre-Release Owner authorization

pre_release_checkpoint authorizes exactly Update-Source, Update-Check, and Selection with the Study-derived 125 positions
release_tail requires a separate authorization for exactly Release-ID, Release-OOD, and Replay with the Study-derived 450 positions
Release authorization binds an immutable verified SELECT digest and governed Candidate ID
HOLD or selection_hold_outcome.json prevents Release authorization
wrong confirmation, experiment, protocol, study, source, scope, stage, Selection, digest, or task-position count fails closed; idempotent creation also rejects an actor change

limitations: the authorization artifact records an explicit operator boundary but is not a cryptographic human identity signature
zero-model validation does not authorize or predict the outcome of the next paid experiment
